text:
Renee (CS): CareHope renewal flagged — they asked for a 12-month price hold but want to add 150 seats immediately. Procurement also asks Net60 because they're a non-profit. PO came in but doesn't reference the seat addendum.
Tom (Account Exec): Marta said budget committee approved seats but only with price hold. Their PO number: CH-PO-3321.
Marta (CareHope): Hi all 12 Frankly we need the price stabilized for 12 months to keep donor-funded programs intact. AP will pay Net60 for non-profits. Attached PO (no seat line): https://files.carehope.example/CH-PO-3321.pdf
Ivy (Finance): Net60 for non-profits is ok after verification, but we need the PO to include a line-item for 150 add-on seats or a signed amendment that references CH-PO-3321.
Renee (CS): DocuSign envelope env-3321 created with amendment template but signer on PO is "Procurement Officer - Jamal Aziz"; we need delegation if Jamal signed on behalf of CFO for contractual changes.
Leo (Legal): For price hold + seat add, we require an amendment with explicit term: "Price held at $0.08/token for 12 months for seats 1-150" and a signer who is authorized. If Jamal is procurement officer, we need either a delegation email or the CFO's signature.
Marta (CareHope): Jamal is authorized to sign procurement items up to $50k; the amendment crosses that limit. CFO is traveling but can reply-all with authority note. I'll get the CFO to confirm.
Marta (CareHope): CFO email: "I, Priya Menon (CFO), authorize Jamal Aziz to sign the attached amendment CH-AM-07 referencing PO CH-PO-3321." Attached signed image.
Ivy (Finance): Great. Also need non-profit verification doc to accept Net60 (copy of 501(c)(3) or local equivalent).
Marta (CareHope): Uploading 501c3: https://files.carehope.example/501c3.pdf
Renee (CS): Updating envelope with CH-AM-07 content, setting invoice field to "CH-PO-3321" and noting payment term Net60. Resent. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-3321
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-3321 status=completed
Billing Bot: Invoice created referencing CH-PO-3321, term Net60, line-item 150 seats, first invoice due 2026-06-30.
Ivy (Finance): I'll attach the 501(c)(3) to the AR file and mark Net60 approval. We will process per Net60 timeline.
Leo (Legal): Amendment signed and saved. Note to CS: price-hold combined with add-on needs a note in CRM about capacity planning; ops should be ready for seat provisioning.
Renee (CS): Noted, creating onboarding ticket to provision 150 seats after renewal complete. Closing thread: renewal executed, delay ~48hrs waiting on CFO delegation and non-profit docs.
Marta (CareHope): Thank you all 12 we can proceed on our side.
Tom (Account Exec): Marking as closed in CRM and following up on provisioning next week.
